# Subway Seat for zsh-syntax-highlighting

The same command-line colors as the fish port: gold commands, orange keywords and separators, sage options, avocado strings, terracotta expansions and redirections. It also colors zsh-autosuggestions' suggestions to match fish's.

[zsh-syntax-highlighting](https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/zsh-syntax-highlighting/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.zshrc, before or after zsh-syntax-highlighting is loaded (the end is fine):

```sh
source ~/.config/zsh/subway-seat.zsh
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.zshrc, before or after zsh-syntax-highlighting is loaded (the end is fine):

```sh
source ~/.config/zsh/subway-seat-tunnel.zsh
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.zshrc, before or after zsh-syntax-highlighting is loaded (the end is fine):

source ~/.config/zsh/subway-seat-enamel.zsh
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.zshrc, before or after zsh-syntax-highlighting is loaded (the end is fine):

```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.zshrc, before or after zsh-syntax-highlighting is loaded (the end is fine):

```

**London Portland**, in ~/.zshrc, before or after zsh-syntax-highlighting is loaded (the end is fine):

```

**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.zshrc, before or after zsh-syntax-highlighting is loaded (the end is fine):

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.zshrc, before or after zsh-syntax-highlighting is loaded (the end is fine):

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/zsh/subway-seat.zsh`.
- Delete `~/.config/zsh/subway-seat-tunnel.zsh`.
- Delete `~/.config/zsh/subway-seat-enamel.zsh`.
- Delete `~/.config/zsh/london-moquette.zsh`.
- Delete `~/.config/zsh/london-deep-level.zsh`.
- Delete `~/.config/zsh/london-portland.zsh`.
- Delete `~/.config/zsh/paris-guimard.zsh`.
- Delete `~/.config/zsh/paris-catacombes.zsh`.
- Delete `~/.config/zsh/paris-carrelage.zsh`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
